ctx.x: Right. Well, the Louie -- Louie Russell, the piano player, had the band for Louie. So Jack Teagarden -- Louie said, called me up, said, Hap, said, got a

you, I said, we called him Pops session for (unintelligible) Okay, Pops (unintelligible), called him Okay, Louie. So we have a -- come on down -- studio. We went down that morning, and there ain't nothing written printing out, and the blues, you know, Pops said, we're going to play a little blues. Okay. So what do you make of them? After we'd made the thing, he called it "Knocking the Jug."
Well, what the title came from, Louie didn't drink, very little. Louie didn't drink much. But --
